dashboard.totalOutstandingHelp: Total amount due from all active customers

customers.title: Customer Accounts
customers.searchPlaceholder: Search by customer name, phone, or address...
customers.emptyDesc: Get started by adding your first customer account to track credits and payments.
customers.emptySearchDesc: Try adjusting your search query or clear the filter.

addCustomer.title: Add New Customer
addCustomer.desc: Create a new customer account. Phone number serves as the unique account ID.
addCustomer.phoneHelp: Phone number will be normalized and cannot be changed later.
addCustomer.addressPlaceholder: e.g. Shop 14, Main Market, Chandni Chowk, Delhi

editCustomer.title: Edit Customer Details
editCustomer.desc: Update customer name and address. Phone number cannot be modified.
editCustomer.phoneLockedNotice: Phone numbers cannot be changed as they are unique identifiers.

credit.title: Add Credit (Amount Due)
credit.desc: Record goods or services provided on credit. This increases the amount due.

debit.title: Record Payment (Debit)
debit.desc: Record a payment received from customer. This decreases the amount due.
debit.zeroBalanceAlertDelete: Notice: Paying the full outstanding balance of {amount} will bring the balance to exactly ₹0.00. Under current settings, this account and its transaction history will be automatically deleted.
debit.zeroBalanceAlertArchive: Notice: Paying the full outstanding balance of {amount} will bring the balance to exactly ₹0.00. Under current settings, this account will be automatically archived.

ledger.title: Customer Ledger & Transaction History
ledger.emptyTx: No transactions recorded for this customer yet.
ledger.addTxPrompt: Use the Credit or Debit buttons to record the first transaction.

settings.title: Ledger System Settings
settings.desc: Configure business rules for customer account management.
settings.zeroBalanceHelp: Choose what happens when a customer payment brings their balance to exactly zero:
settings.optionDeleteDesc: Instantly deletes the customer account and transaction records upon full payment to keep only active debt accounts.
settings.optionArchiveDesc: Marks the customer account as archived upon full payment, preserving full transaction records for future auditing.

auth.signInDesc: Sign in with your authorized administrator credentials to manage customer accounts and ledger records.
auth.accessDeniedMessage: You have signed in successfully, but your Clerk account is not authorized as an administrator.
auth.howToFix: How to designate an admin in Clerk:
auth.step4: 4. Refresh this page to access the application.

notifications.zeroBalanceDeletedNotice: Account and transaction history were deleted because the balance reached zero.
notifications.zeroBalanceArchivedNotice: Account has been archived because the balance reached zero. Transaction history preserved.
notifications.networkError: Could not connect to the server. Please check your connection.

validation.phoneRequired: Valid phone number (10 to 15 digits) is required.
validation.amountPositive: Amount must be a positive number greater than zero.
validation.debitExceedsBalance: Debit amount cannot exceed current outstanding balance of {balance}.
validation.duplicatePhone: A customer with this phone number already exists.

backup.title: Complete Database Backup
backup.desc: Extract all customer accounts and transaction ledgers in tabular format and download as PDF.

calls.title: Daily Customer Call Queue
calls.subtitle: 50 customers scheduled for each day. Ordered by last update date with newest at the end.
calls.circularNotice: Queue automatically repeats from Day 1 when the list ends.
calls.remarkPlaceholder: e.g. Called customer, promised payment by Friday...
calls.emptyDesc: There are no active customer accounts available in the call queue.
calls.pdfDownloadSuccess: Call list PDF for Day {day} downloaded successfully.
